context: Tests whether the agent uses the api.py programmatic interface (run() function) rather than only the CLI, and whether the warfarin multi-gene special case (CYP2C9 + VKORC1) is correctly captured in both the API output and the CLI report.

checklist.name: pgx_analysis.py uses api.py
checklist.description: pgx_analysis.py imports from api (e.g. 'from api import run' or 'import api') rather than calling subprocess or os.system to run the CLI

checklist.name: api run() called
checklist.description: pgx_analysis.py calls the run() function from the api module with a genotypes dictionary argument

checklist.name: analysis_result.json present
checklist.description: A file named analysis_result.json is present in the working directory

checklist.name: analysis_result.json has gene_profiles
checklist.description: analysis_result.json contains a 'gene_profiles' key with gene-level data

checklist.name: analysis_result.json has drug_recommendations
checklist.description: analysis_result.json contains a 'drug_recommendations' key with categorised drug data

checklist.name: Warfarin multi-gene in API output
checklist.description: analysis_result.json (or pgx_analysis.py output) references both CYP2C9 and VKORC1 in the context of Warfarin

checklist.name: Warfarin AVOID in CLI report
checklist.description: The cli_report/report.md file classifies Warfarin as AVOID (patient has CYP2C9 *1/*3 + VKORC1 AA = high sensitivity)

checklist.name: cli_report/report.md present
checklist.description: A file named report.md exists under cli_report/

checklist.name: cli_report/result.json present
checklist.description: A file named result.json exists under cli_report/

checklist.name: Medical disclaimer in CLI report
checklist.description: cli_report/report.md contains a disclaimer about research/educational use only
